title: Workflow Gym task manifest
description: A reproducible benchmark task in a versioned Workflow Gym dataset.

apiVersion.description: Version of the Workflow Gym task contract.

taskId.description: Unique stable identifier for this task within its dataset.

datasetVersion.description: Immutable version shared by every task in this dataset.

split.description: Explicit train, evaluation, or holdout assignment.

provenance.description: Immutable source material from which the task was derived.

source.description: Repository, dataset, or other source identifier.

revision.description: Immutable source revision or content digest.

seed.description: Deterministic seed used to prepare and evaluate the task.

generatorVersion.description: Version of the pure generator that produced this task.

constraints.description: Closed, generator-defined constraints applied to this task.

minimalReproductionId.description: Stable identifier for the smallest reproduction of this generated task.

expectedOutcome.description: Outcome a successful candidate is expected to produce.

expectedFailureMode.description: Optional failure mode the evaluator is expected to detect.

retention.description: Retention constraints for task inputs and outputs.

retainUntil.description: Optional last date on which retained material is allowed.

licensing.description: License and attribution metadata for task material.

license.description: SPDX expression or other unambiguous license identifier.

attribution.description: Optional attribution required when using the task material.

candidateEnvironment.description: Pinned environment manifest presented to benchmark candidates.

image.description: Immutable image reference, including a digest or equivalent version pin.

environment.description: Non-secret environment values supplied to the candidate.
